qualification.details: The essential qualification is department-specific. In general, candidates need a postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the relevant subject from a recognised university/institute, or an equivalent qualification; certain super-specialty departments (Cardiology, Neurology, Nephrology, Medical Oncology, Neonatology, Radiotherapy, etc.) also accept an eligible MD/DNB in an allied broad specialty (e.g., Medicine or Paediatrics) as an alternative route. Two departments - Anatomy and Pharmacology - additionally accept Non-Medical candidates (for the Senior Demonstrator post) holding an M.Sc./M.Biotech plus a Ph.D. in the concerned or allied subject from a recognised University/Institute. | The cut-off date to determine eligibility in all respects for Cycle-2 is 30.09.2026 (Wednesday). To be eligible, a candidate must have passed the qualifying degree examination, with the result declared, on or before this cut-off date; the tenure of the qualifying degree must also be complete by this date. Based on the information provided in the online application, candidates are provisionally permitted to appear for the interview without prior scrutiny of documents. On the day of interview, documents relating to essential qualification, age, category, experience (wherever applicable), and NOC will be scrutinised by the Institute's Scrutiny Committee - only candidates found eligible by the Committee will be permitted to appear for the interview. If ineligibility is detected at any stage, the candidate's candidature will be cancelled without notice. | OBC candidates must possess a valid caste certificate. Since these vacancies are advertised in financial year 2026-27, only an NCL-OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 will be considered valid - a certificate issued before this date will render the OBC candidature invalid and stand cancelled. EWS candidates must possess a valid EWS certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026. | Candidates already in-service in any Government Hospital/Institution/Government Organisation must submit their application through proper channel, or alternatively produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer/competent authority on the date of interview - failing which they may not be allowed to appear for the interview.

how_to_apply: Read the detailed base Rolling Advertisement (Employment Notification No. 03/2026, dated 30.03.2026) carefully before applying, as all its terms and conditions apply to this Cycle-2 unless modified here.
Apply online during the application window: 19.09.2026 (Saturday) to 30.09.2026 (Wednesday).
Fill in the application form with accurate personal, educational, and category details as per the requirements laid out in the base Rolling Advertisement.
Report for interview at the notified venue (Board Room, 6th Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Vijaypur, Jammu-181134) at the reporting time of 9:30 AM, on the interview date(s) to be notified separately.

Carry all original documents relating to essential qualification, age, category, experience (wherever applicable), and NOC (if applicable) for scrutiny by the Institute's Scrutiny Committee on the day of interview.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jammu SR Recruitment 2026 (Cycle-2) Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: 86 tentative Senior Resident/Demonstrator posts (including backlog posts) are notified across 35 departments/specialties for Cycle-2. Candidates meeting the eligibility criteria (including reservation) for posts under "Column A" departments may also apply and be considered for posts under the corresponding "Column B" departments. If no suitable candidate is selected in a Column B department, the post will be offered to willing candidates selected in the corresponding Column A department. All eligible applicants, irrespective of their own category, may also be considered for seats advertised under a reservation category. If candidates are not available in the reservation category for which a seat is advertised, candidates from other categories (including Unreserved) will be considered for appointment, not exceeding 44 days beyond the process (extendable by the competent authority), strictly as per Government of India guidelines.

content_sections.heading: AIIMS Jammu SR Recruitment 2026 (Cycle-2) Eligibility Criteria (Department-wise)
content_sections.text: The essential qualification is department-specific. In general, candidates need a postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the relevant subject from a recognised university/institute, or an equivalent qualification; certain super-specialty departments (Cardiology, Neurology, Nephrology, Medical Oncology, Neonatology, Radiotherapy, etc.) also accept an eligible MD/DNB in an allied broad specialty (e.g., Medicine or Paediatrics) as an alternative route. Two departments - Anatomy and Pharmacology - additionally accept Non-Medical candidates (for the Senior Demonstrator post) holding an M.Sc./M.Biotech plus a Ph.D. in the concerned or allied subject from a recognised University/Institute. The cut-off date to determine eligibility in all respects for Cycle-2 is 30.09.2026 (Wednesday) . To be eligible, a candidate must have passed the qualifying degree examination, with the result declared, on or before this cut-off date; the tenure of the qualifying degree must also be complete by this date. Based on the information provided in the online application, candidates are provisionally permitted to appear for the interview without prior scrutiny of documents. On the day of interview, documents relating to essential qualification, age, category, experience (wherever applicable), and NOC will be scrutinised by the Institute's Scrutiny Committee - only candidates found eligible by the Committee will be permitted to appear for the interview. If ineligibility is detected at any stage, the candidate's candidature will be cancelled without notice. OBC candidates must possess a valid caste certificate. Since these vacancies are advertised in financial year 2026-27, only an NCL-OBC certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026 will be considered valid - a certificate issued before this date will render the OBC candidature invalid and stand cancelled. EWS candidates must possess a valid EWS certificate issued on or after 01.04.2026. Candidates already in-service in any Government Hospital/Institution/Government Organisation must submit their application through proper channel, or alternatively produce a No Objection Certificate (NOC) from their employer/competent authority on the date of interview - failing which they may not be allowed to appear for the interview.

faq.question: Q1. What is AIIMS Jammu SR Recruitment 2026 (Cycle-2)?
faq.answer: It is Cycle-2 of AIIMS Vijaypur, Jammu's Rolling Advertisement (Employment Notification No. 04/2026) for Senior Resident/Demonstrator posts, supplementing the base Rolling Advertisement (Employment Notification No. 03/2026 dated 30.03.2026).

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in AIIMS Jammu SR Recruitment 2026 (Cycle-2)?
faq.answer: There are 86 tentative Senior Resident/Demonstrator posts (including backlog posts) across 35 departments/specialties for Cycle-2.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Jammu SR Recruitment 2026 (Cycle-2)?
faq.answer: The online application closes on 30.09.2026 (Wednesday), which is also the cut-off date for determining eligibility.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for AIIMS Jammu Senior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The essential qualification is department-specific, generally a postgraduate medical degree (MD/MS/DNB) in the relevant subject; some super-specialty departments accept an allied broad-specialty MD/DNB as an alternative, and Anatomy/Pharmacology also accept Non-Medical candidates with an M.Sc./M.Biotech plus Ph.D. for the Senior Demonstrator post.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee and age limit for AIIMS Jammu SR Recruitment 2026 (Cycle-2)?
faq.answer: These are not specified in this Cycle-2 notice; candidates should refer to the base Rolling Advertisement (Employment Notification No. 03/2026, dated 30.03.2026) for fee and age limit details.

faq.question: Q6. When will the AIIMS Jammu SR Cycle-2 interview be held?
faq.answer: The exact interview date(s) will be notified separately; the venue is the Board Room, 6th Floor, Academic Block, AIIMS Vijaypur, Jammu, with a reporting time of 9:30 AM.

faq.question: Q7. Is there a written exam for AIIMS Jammu SR Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No written exam is mentioned in this notice - selection is through document scrutiny followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can a General Surgery candidate apply for Cardiothoracic Surgery or Neurosurgery posts?
faq.answer: Yes. Eligible candidates for General Surgery (Column A) may also apply and be considered for Burns & Plastic Surgery, Cardiothoracic Surgery, Neurosurgery, Paediatric Surgery, Surgical Gastroenterology, and Trauma & Emergency Medicine (Column B), if no suitable candidate is found directly in those departments.
